Any claim for refund or credit may be reviewed by the IRS. If you claim a refund or credit on your federal tax return of more than $2 million ($5 million for a C corporation), the IRS must review the refund or credit and provide a report to the Joint Committee on Taxation (JCT). Refunds or credits for which a report must be provided to the JCT are referred to here as a Joint Committee refund case (“JC refund case”). The JCT is a non-partisan committee of the United States Congress. This program is part of the IRS’s Large Business and International Division. pages.text: Largest 'Sea Dragon' Fossil Accidentally Discovered in Museum | National Geographic 1:00 Artist's impression of the Ichthyosaurus ILLUSTRATION BY JOSCHUA KNÜPPE Largest 'Sea Dragon' Fossil Accidentally Discovered in Museum The paleontologist who made the discovery was originally at the museum to study a fossil that resembles the Loch Ness monster. By Sarah Gibbens Published August 28, 2017 • 4 min read Sven Sachs, a paleontologist from the Bielefeld Natural History Museum in Germany, was at the Lower Saxony State Museum in Hannover to study an ancient sea reptile when one of the museum's display fossils caught his eye. The specimen had originally been unearthed in the mid-1990s in Somerset, England, but it had remained largely unstudied since. Sachs suspected it was an Ichthyosaurus. Commonly mistaken for a dinosaur, the species was more like a "sea dragon" marine reptile that had a long, flexible body and may have swum like eels. "I found it very extraordinary," said Sachs. "[It was] way bigger than any specimen I had examined." He explained the specimen had previously been labeled as a smaller species within the Ichthyosaurus group. Sachs reached out to Ichthyosaurus expert Dean Lomax from the University of Manchester, and in early 2017 they examined the specimen together, finding it to be a specimen of the species Ichthyosaurus somersetensis . Skeleton of Ichthyosaurus . Photograph by Dean Lomax Their findings, published in the journal Acta Palaeontologica Polonica , describe the largest known specimen of its kind. Mr. Stubblefield joined the SBA in 2016, serving as the Assistant Administrator for the Office of Equal Employment Opportunity & Civil Rights Compliance, and most recently as the Associate Administrator for OVBD. Prior to the SBA, he held numerous leadership positions with the US Army, including Deputy Assistant Secretary of the Army for Diversity and Leadership. Mr. Stubblefield has first-hand military experience, having served 30 years as an enlisted soldier and active duty officer in the US Army. In 2005, he retired from the military as a Colonel and was appointed to the Senior Executive Service. Mr. Stubblefield is the recipient of the Distinguished Presidential Rank Award, holds an MBA from the University of Tennessee and a BS in Business Management from Embry Riddle Aeronautical University.

This trick of the light is turning out to be an important tool for 3D-printing metal, a process in which high-powered lasers melt metal powder one layer at a time. NIST scientists have found that caustic reflections from those lasers contain clues about the metal’s microscopic shape. pages.text: Learn about K-1 fiancé(e) visas and sponsoring a future spouse | USAGov Skip to main content Learn about K-1 fiancé(e) visas and sponsoring a future spouse If you are engaged to a U.S. citizen, you may be able to come to the U.S. to get married. Your future spouse must sponsor you, and you must apply for a K-1 fiancé(e) visa. How to sponsor a fiancé(e) and apply for a K-1 visa If you are engaged to a U.S. citizen and plan to marry and live in the U.S., your fiancé(e) must sponsor you first by filing a petition. After your fiancé(e)’s petition is approved, you can apply for a K-1 visa to come to the U.S. Follow the steps to petition for a fiancé(e) and to apply for a K-1 visa. On that page, you will also learn: What documentation proves your eligibility by confirming your: Relationship with your future spouse Identity Income or financial support How to bring eligible children What forms to use What fees you must pay What happens after your K-1 visa is approved? If you are issued a K-1 visa: You must travel to the United States to marry your fiancé(e) within 90 days of arriving. After you marry, you may apply for an adjustment of status to get a Permanent Resident (Green) Card. K-1 visas expire after 90 days and cannot be extended. If you do not marry within 90 days, you must leave the country or face possible deportation. LAST UPDATED: March 17, 2026 SHARE THIS PAGE: Have a question? The Tuskegee Airmen were the first African Americans trained and qualified to serve as military aviators in the U.S. Army Air Forces during World War II. The term refers collectively to the pilots as well as the navigators, bombardiers, instructors, mechanics, nurses, and other support personnel who participated in the Tuskegee Experience, the Army Air Forces’ program for training African American aviation personnel between 1941 and 1946. Trained at Moton Field and Tuskegee Army Air Field in Alabama, they served in the United States and overseas, flying combat, escort, reconnaissance, and transport missions in the European and Mediterranean theaters while supporting the Army Air Forces’ wartime operations. pages.text: Learn about the United States' founding documents | USAGov Skip to main content Learn about the United States' founding documents The Declaration of Independence, U.S. Constitution, and Bill of Rights, known together as the Charters of Freedom, established the government’s structure and continue to secure the rights of American citizens. Declaration of Independence The Declaration of Independence proclaimed that the American colonies were separating from British rule, and detailed the reasons. On July 4, 1776, Congress voted to accept the Declaration of Independence, marking July 4 as Independence Day. Thomas Jefferson, the principal author, drafted the document in 17 days. U.S. Constitution The Constitution of the United States set up the foundation of the U.S. government, including its purpose and structure. The Constitutional Convention adopted the Constitution on September 17, 1787. Bill of Rights The Bill of Rights is the first 10 amendments (changes) to the U.S. Constitution. It guarantees greater protection for individual freedoms and lists specific limits on government power. The Constitution has 27 amendments in all. Their descendants, including people from the Hopi, Paiute, Zuni, Ute, and Navajo tribes, have strong ties to this land today, leaving behind rock art panels, occupation sites, campsites and granaries. Stepping further back in time, fossil excavations have yielded more information about ecosystem change at the end of the dinosaur era than any other place in the world. The Monument’s size, resources, and remote character provide extraordinary opportunities for geologists, paleontologists, archeologists, historians, and biologists in scientific research, education, and exploration. This unspoiled natural area also remains a frontier with countless opportunities for quiet recreation and solitude. Cecilia Peterson December 9, 2021 Get our Newsletter! Get our Newsletter! My grandpa Harold, uncle Curt, cousin Eric, grandma Lucille, and cousin Nils at Christmas in the early 1980s. Photo courtesy of Cecilia Peterson When my friend Kat returned from a vacation in Sweden this year, she told me, “Hey, did you know that no one knows what potatis korv is there? People were confused whenever I asked about it.” Now, I don’t believe most people speak so casually about obscure sausage varieties, but Kat happens to have made potatis korv with me for years, in preparation for my annual Christmas smörgåsbord . I’ve never been to Sweden myself, despite exactly half of my ancestors claiming Swedish heritage. Still, it surprised me—I can’t remember a year in my life where my Grandma Lucille laid out the smörgåsbord and the korv was missing. But apparently, potatis korv is a regional dish, though Swedish Americans all over the United States may know exactly what it is. pages.text: Leonardo's horse took 500 years to make | National Geographic Published April 30, 2019 • 2 min read Studies of horses drawn by Leonardo da Vinci circa 1490, when he was planning “Il Gran Cavallo.” Collection of the Royal Library, Windsor Castle, Windsor, England Photograph by Print Collector/Album At the request of Ludovico Sforza, the future Duke of Milan , Leonardo da Vinci began working on a sculpture that would be the largest equestrian statue in the world in 1482. Leonardo made sketches of the horses in the Sforza stables, from which he designed a 24-foot-high clay model. Leonardo wanted to cast the horse in a single operation and designed elaborate plaster molds to make that possible. In his innovative process, the inverted molds would be buried between two ovens, and molten bronze would fill them to cast the statue. War versus art The plans were set to create the giant horse, but war with France engulfed Milan in 1499. Sforza needed the bronze for weapons, not art, and the materials were diverted to forge cannons. The French defeated Milan, occupied Sforza's lands, and destroyed the clay horse. Leonardo ’s drawings and plans survived, but the artist died in May 1519 before “Il Gran Cavallo” could be brought to life. Dent made it his life’s work to erect the statue. pages.title: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver says there are no trust issues between himself and team - BBC Sport
pages.description: Lewis Hamilton says Ferrari are "super united" despite two recent incidents in which the British driver ignored a team call to pit for fresh tyres.
pages.text: Lewis Hamilton: Ferrari driver says there are no trust issues between himself and team - BBC Sport Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Lewis Hamilton is fourth in the 2026 F1 drivers' championship By Andrew Benson F1 Correspondent Published 4 hours ago Lewis Hamilton says there is "definitely not" a trust problem between him and his Ferrari team. The seven-time champion has twice in the past four races ignored a call to pit for fresh tyres, both times to his competitive disadvantage. The most recent time, in the Sao Paulo Grand Prix on 8 November, Hamilton stayed out on worn slick tyres in worsening rain and ended up spinning before pitting on the next lap. Before this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix, Hamilton spoke positively of his relationship with his race engineer Carlo Santi. "We're constantly working on our communication," said Hamilton, who had a different race engineer last year. "It's been a lot better this year. Carlos (sic) has done an amazing job. And those particular two times, particularly the last time, was just I didn't have the information I needed. I got the call right at the last minute. "We'll just continue to work on the processes. We're super united in what's working, in the right direction." The previous time Hamilton ignored a call to pit was in Singapore, when he decided to stay out during a virtual safety car period. He later apologised . At the following race in Austin, he explained that he was "always looking at ways to win, always looking at doing potentially something different. pages.title: Lewis Moody: England team to support MND challenge at All Blacks match - BBC Sport
pages.description: Lewis Moody says he has been buoyed by the current England team's support as he launches his latest challenge in aid of Motor Neurone Disease (MND) research.
pages.text: Lewis Moody: England team to support MND challenge at All Blacks match - BBC Sport Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Moody spoke to England's players in the dressing room after last November's win over Australia, shortly after revealing his MND diagnosis By Mike Henson BBC Sport rugby union news reporter Published 17 November 2026 Lewis Moody says he has been buoyed by the England team's support as he launches his latest challenge in aid of Motor Neurone Disease (MND) research at Saturday's match against New Zealand at Allianz Stadium. England will wear training tops and specially-painted boots publicising Moody's 'Front Up' campaign, which is calling on supporters to converge on the British coastline in June for a day of fundraising walks. "I just couldn't be more grateful to the team, the lads that have been in touch and the energy and excitement they have wanted to bring to this," said Moody. "To have their buy-in is wonderful for me. It speaks to the connection the rugby family has, whatever the team, the era, the nationality, and the strength of that bond." Moody, who won 71 England caps, was part of the 2003 Rugby World Cup-winning side and captained the team at the 2011 tournament. He was diagnosed with MND last year. The muscle-wasting condition impacted the lives of Doddie Weir, the former Scotland and British and Irish Lions second row, and rugby league star Rob Burrow in recent years. Both have since died. Close lhirlimann's Diary Capitole du Libre 2026 Posted by lhirlimann on 15 November 2026 in French (Français) . Hier soir, j’ai présenté dans l’amphithéâtre C002 au sein du campus de enseeiht à Toulouse, « Contribuez à OSM ». La bonne surprise fut le taux de remplissage de la salle. J’ai compté plus d’une vingtaine de personnes. La présentation était articulée en deux parties : la première, un tout petit peu de théorie et pas de présentation d’outils ; la deuxième, des démonstrations, des petits trucs faciles pour commencer, puis des trucs plus « grands » (de l’infrastructure). En trente minutes, j’avais plié ma présentation. Il restait vingt-cinq minutes, qui se sont très, très facilement remplies par de très nombreuses questions. Merci au plublic pour ces questions. Merci à l’organisation du Capitole du Libre. La présentation est disponible à https://files.hirlimann.net/talks/cdl2026/ .
